assessments.summary: The exact 152-point configuration is absent from the permitted evidence, so the checker cannot be reproduced and the saturation, removal, embedding-count, and output-binding claims cannot be verified. This is an evidentiary gap, not a counterexample. Conditional on supplying the intended configuration and a successful default execution of the audited checker, its exact-integer logic appears sound, and the stated corollary follows correctly from claims 1–3.
scopeQualifications: The checker statically validates cardinality, distinctness, bounds, absence of collinear triples, embedding counts, every outside cell, removal sets of size at most two, and agreement of independent census and pair-walk methods.

Conditional on recomputation and byte agreement with results.json, the stronger blocking-pair count, exactly 16 exceptional removal pairs, their concentration on four cells, and the two-lines-of-two pattern would be established.
The symmetric-difference corollary is logically valid conditional on the computational claims.
evidenceIssues: No dependency transaction is declared or allowed; a prose reference to another transaction cannot supply the missing premise.
Neither a SHA-256 value nor pointsDigest reconstructs the 152 coordinates.
results.json contains aggregates and exceptional pairs but is insufficient to reconstruct the configuration or independently check all 5777 outside cells.

Unverified facts include the intended decoded coordinates, their validity as a 152-point no-three-in-line subset of G_76, the two dihedral images and eight embeddings, and reproduction of the committed results.json.
